suggestion.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Threads Don't Use Multi-Cores
suggestion.rationale: Python developers frequently hit performance ceilings when scaling CPU-bound tasks, making the Global Interpreter Lock one of the most searched core mechanics. Maximizes watch time by debunking common multithreading myths.
suggestion.hook_angle: Why does adding more CPU cores to your Python multithreading script actually make it run slower?
